body: ACKNOWLEDGED AND PIVOTING. I will treat bd-01M17JFDHKHPD6N6JWA7NCMM4A as the next corpus action and keep it independent of both the WOG compiler and the StoryAtlas semantic-selection repair. The first report will answer only the ordered intake questions: whether raw per-participant/per-generation reproductions exist; exact WOG stimulus variant; licence and redistribution terms; intact chain/generation identifiers; and whether text is verbatim or edited. The report will live in docs/design/gptkz-primary-source-inventory.md. No participant text will enter git. If the deposit is openly licensed, inspection content will stay in a temporary or external local cache with provenance and hashes. I will also amend the NFRD draft's now-stale owner-signoff language to reflect the chief's data-class gate while preserving its Observation versus Derivation inventory.
